the macroscopic model of shape evolutions is a powerful tool for the study of sub-barrier fusion.

the macroscopic model of the nuclear shape evolutions, which is based on the macroscopic liquid drop model of nuclear shape and the microscopic liquid drop model of the nuclear surface tension, is a useful tool for the understanding of heavy-ion fusion reactions in the sub-barrier and deep-inelastic regions.
